title: 通过声学掩蔽量化辅音对词可理解性的贡献
summary: 本文提出一种可扩展方法，通过逐个静音单词中的辅音并测试ASR模型是否仍能识别该词，定义掩蔽诱导误识率（MMR）来量化辅音贡献。在英、西、德、捷四种语言及MMS、Whisper、Qwen3-ASR三种架构上验证，发现音素频率与MMR负相关、功能负载正相关，且辅音贡献排序具有语言依赖性。
summary_en: This paper presents a scalable method to measure consonant contribution to word intelligibility via acoustic masking: silencing one consonant at a time and testing whether an ASR model still recognizes the word, defining the mask-induced misrecognition rate (MMR). Validated across English, Spanish, German, and Czech using MMS, Whisper, and Qwen3-ASR, it finds phoneme frequency negatively and functional load positively correlated with MMR, with rankings being language-dependent.
